refinementDetails.descriptionEnglish: Max HP increases by <color=#99FFFFFF>10%</color>. When triggering Lunar reactions or inflicting Lunar Reaction DMG on opponents, the equipping character will recover <color=#99FFFFFF>14</color> Energy, and receive the Bountiful Sea's Sacred Wine effect for 12s: Max HP increases by an additional <color=#99FFFFFF>14%</color>, CRIT DMG from Lunar Reaction DMG increases by <color=#99FFFFFF>60%</color>. The Energy recovery effect can be triggered at most once every 18s, and can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.

refinementDetails.name: 末临者的华冠
refinementDetails.description: 攻击力提升<color=#99FFFFFF>12%</color>。装备者创造护盾后的20秒内，获得「先导之光」效果：依据装备者的攻击力，每1000点攻击力都会使队伍中自己的当前场上角色造成的伤害提升<color=#99FFFFFF>10%</color>，至多提升<color=#99FFFFFF>26%</color>。此外，装备者创造护盾时，还会获得「指引者的餍足」效果，使装备者恢复<color=#99FFFFFF>14</color>点元素能量，该效果每14秒至多触发一次；在不处于战斗状态下开启各类宝箱时，也会获得该效果。装备者处于队伍后台时，依然能触发上述效果。\n魔导·秘仪：队伍中自己的魔导角色位于队伍后台时，也能获得「先导之光」中50%的伤害提升效果。
refinementDetails.descriptionEnglish: ATK is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>12%</color>. After the equipping character creates a Shield, they gain "Pathfinder's Light" for 20s: Increases your active party member's DMG by <color=#99FFFFFF>10%</color> for every 1,000 ATK the equipping character has, up to a maximum of <color=#99FFFFFF>26%</color>. Additionally, when the equipping character creates a Shield, they will also gain "Guide's Contentment": Restores <color=#99FFFFFF>14</color> Elemental Energy to the equipping character. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 14s, and can also be triggered when any type of chest is opened outside of combat. The equipping character may trigger this effect even when they are an off-field.\nHexerei: Secret Rite: When your own Hexerei character is off-field in the party, they will also gain 50% of the DMG increase from Pathfinder's Light.
